excerpt: The official cause of death was listed as suicide; however, his personnel files recorded that he died due to a heart attack.
note: Contested: official cause suicide vs. heart attack in personnel files.

excerpt: The government reported that he had committed suicide, but Napoleon has often been blamed for orchestrating the murder.
note: Found strangled in his cell in the Temple; officially suicide, murder suspected.

excerpt: According to official sources, Lashevich died from gangrene in Harbin on 30 August 1928. Some other sources claim that he was either killed in a car accident or had committed suicide.
note: Official cause gangrene; alternative accounts say car accident or suicide.

excerpt: The next day he was found shot in his office. ... a second official announcement declared the death as suicide ... [later] said 'to have been murdered by the Sigurimi on behalf of Xoxe, or been forced to suicide'.
note: Official version suicide; after rehabilitation claimed murdered by Sigurimi or forced to suicide.

excerpt: Kruglov died in 1977 under unclear circumstances. Several sources state that Kruglov died due to accidentally being hit by a train. Other sources suggest suicide or a heart attack
note: English article is 'Sergei Kruglov (politician)'. Russian Wikipedia: hit by a train near Pravda platform; date 6 June (ru) vs 6 July (en) 1977, year matches.
